name: Fruitachampsa
isnote: PBDB and English Wikipedia place it in the Shartegosuchidae; the atlas has no clade for that family yet, so it sits in Crocodyliformes.
sum: Fruitachampsa is a small shartegosuchid crocodyliform from the Late Jurassic Morrison Formation of Fruita, Colorado.
wsnote: Less than 1 m long, with a skull up to about 9 cm (English Wikipedia, rev. 1282989540); no precise estimate is given.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted; the genus is known from several specimens from the Fruita Paleontological Area.
material: Multiple specimens from the Fruita Paleontological Area, found from 1975 onwards.
biology: Described as a relatively long-limbed, terrestrial quadrupedal predator with a short face and a pair of canine-like lower teeth (Clark 2011, as summarised on Wikipedia).
author: Clark 2011

images.caption: Fruitachampsa callisoni specimen in the LACM collection.

sources.text: J. M. Clark. 2011. A new shartegosuchid crocodyliform from the Upper Jurassic Morrison Formation of western Colorado. Zoological Journal of the Linnean Society 163:S152-S172
